propositions: The _no_repo_commits autouse guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after each of ~13,255 tests, consuming ~207 runner-seconds (~75s wall-time on macOS, 9.3% of suite runtime).
Per-test Git subprocess overhead must be eliminated while preserving checkout-HEAD move detection, test attribution, allow_repo_writes escape, and session-wide dirty-tree backstop.

In-process HEAD fingerprinting via worktree metadata (symbolic refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, linked worktrees) must be implemented safely without adding Git library dependencies or weakening test-isolation coverage.

OSS consensus (4/4: pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) rejects per-test source-checkout Git subprocesses in the hot path, but no fidelity-preserving implementation primitive (library, hand-parsing, or guard removal) meets automatic-approval bar.
Operator disposition (2026-08-19) accepted wontfix; ticket blocked and administratively closed without implementation.
